name: Meshlet Extraction using Mesh Shader Pipelines
definition: A real-time extraction method using coupled task and mesh shaders to extract meshlets from scalar volumes, addressing PMB's lack of control over meshlet size constraints.
summary: Meshlet Extraction using Mesh Shader Pipelines is a real-time isosurface method that uses coupled task and mesh shaders to partition scalar volumes into size-constrained meshlets, addressing the lack of control over meshlet size constraints in its parent method, Poisson Meshlet-Based Extraction.
